parameters.name: AutoProvisioningGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the auto provisioning group.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query scheduling history. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The current page number in a paging query. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Settings for paging query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the auto provisioning group resides.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query scheduling history. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
